note: A privately run campground on the Nesslin Lake Provincial Recreation Site, on the west edge of Prince Albert National Park ~30 km NE of Big River. The sites sit in mixed forest behind a shore road and a narrow treed beach on the north side of the lake; yurts and a trapper's tent are also rented. Internet is unreliable. --Claude
